_comment: Copy to the path named by VENDOR_TARGETS_FILE (default config/vendor_targets.json).
Targets are configuration, not code: a site is added, paused with
'enabled': false, or deleted outright by editing this file — no code change,
no deploy. A missing file means no scraping at all.
Selector lists are ordered. Index 0 is the element you believe is the real
one; later entries are fallbacks and are scored lower, because 'we found a
number somewhere on the page' is a weaker claim than 'we found the price'.
The slugs below are placeholders. Replace them with real targets you have
checked: confirm the site's robots.txt and terms permit this before adding it.
